value.rationale: The study completely classifies a natural ten-group family of reducts by the oligomorphic scalar invariant and quantitatively locates the information lost by that invariant: 10 distinct closed groups yield exactly 6 all-arity numerical profiles. It independently shows a sharp recovery threshold of three labelled points for the actual orbit partitions, versus impossibility of recovery from all scalar counts. This is a natural model-theoretic reconstruction boundary, not an arbitrary unmotivated finite slice.
